context: Tests whether the agent produces a correctly formatted SATORI_NOTE v6.5 continuity note with all required fields and constraints, includes the required plain-text warning, and correctly describes the cloud-sync safety prohibition when vault initialization is attempted from a cloud-synced directory.

checklist.name: Correct version header
checklist.description: continuity_note.txt contains the exact header 'SATORI_NOTE v6.5' (not v6, not v7, not any other version string)

checklist.name: All required fields present
checklist.description: continuity_note.txt includes all seven required fields: theme, stance, lens, step, anchor_question, session_count, created

checklist.name: Theme character limit
checklist.description: The value of the 'theme' field in continuity_note.txt is 60 characters or fewer

checklist.name: Valid stance value
checklist.description: The 'stance' field in continuity_note.txt is exactly one of: mirror, balanced, candid — no other values accepted

checklist.name: Lens character limit
checklist.description: The value of the 'lens' field in continuity_note.txt is 40 characters or fewer

checklist.name: Valid step value
checklist.description: The 'step' field in continuity_note.txt is exactly one of: attune, clarify, formulate, integrate, translate, anchor — no other values accepted

checklist.name: Anchor question character limit
checklist.description: The value of the 'anchor_question' field in continuity_note.txt is 140 characters or fewer

checklist.name: Total note character limit
checklist.description: The entire SATORI_NOTE block in continuity_note.txt (from 'SATORI_NOTE v6.5' to the last field) is 600 characters or fewer

checklist.name: Plain-text warning included
checklist.description: continuity_note.txt includes a warning that the note is plain text and should only be pasted into chats the user trusts (or equivalent wording conveying the same caution)

checklist.name: Vault init halts for cloud sync
checklist.description: vault_init_response.txt states that initialization halts (stops/errors/refuses) when a cloud-synced directory is detected — does NOT say initialization proceeds silently or warns but continues

checklist.name: Allow-synced flag mentioned
checklist.description: vault_init_response.txt mentions --allow-synced as the flag the user must explicitly pass to allow initialization to proceed in a cloud-synced location

checklist.name: Note is data-only
checklist.description: The SATORI_NOTE block in continuity_note.txt contains only data fields — no instructional text, advice, or conversational prose inside the note block itself
